messages:
emma: opened PR to update Zenith13b model card in the catalog. Goals: add migration checklist for zenith->zenith-quant, clarify runtime compatibility, include a tiny bench table and SDK snippet, and replace an outdated quant link. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5299
raj: please call out sequence ceiling for zenith-quant on constrained hosts (we've seen KV-cache trim at 6144 tokens; customers hit silent truncation).
cam: for the runtime matrix: runtime 3.1 -> partial for zenith-quant-v1 (missing fused-attn); runtime 3.3+ -> full. I'll drop a short sentence.
emma: adding a separate "Migration" subsection with checklist steps (staging tests, evals, family pin, monitor MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK events). Also swapping docs/old-quant-guide.md -> docs/quant/overview.md and will add a redirect.
raj: bench numbers: p4d fp16 pinned zenith-13b: 860 toks/s (seq512, batch=1). zenith-13b-quant coldpath: 660 toks/s. runtime 3.3 + selector: quant ~820 toks/s. I'll attach CSV to the PR.
cam: SDK snippet to include three cases:
```
# exact pin
client.generate(model="zenith-13b@2026-06-10", prompt="...")
# family pin (allow compatible variants)
client.generate(model="zenith-13b@stable", prompt="...")
# unpinned (auto-upgrade)
client.generate(model="zenith-13b", prompt="...")
```
emma: good. will also add a short paragraph: when to prefer exact pin (repro), family pin (balanced updates + fixes), unpinned (auto improvements).
docs-bot: PR #5299 opened by emma: docs/model-catalog: zenith13b card updates + migration checklist (labels: docs, model-catalog)
raj: tiny nit: include measurement conditions in the bench table (batch=1, seq=512, cold vs warmed).
cam: found a stale link to docs/quant-old.md; will open a redirect PR for that after this thread.
emma: assigning follow-ups: raj - CSV + raw bench logs; cam - snippet PR + redirect; i'll update the card and request reviews by EOD.
raj: uploading CSV in 20m.
cam: +1
emma: merging after CI + one approval if no blockers. thanks! :rocket:
